paragraphs: A browser-based Fifth Edition character generator built from the supplied books. The core book and opt-in Up in Arms, Archives of the Empire I, II and III, Winds of Magic, Rough Nights & Hard Days, High Elf Player’s Guide, Dwarf Player’s Guide, Blood and Bramble, and Deft Steps, Light Fingers are installed. Compatibility decisions and exclusions are documented separately for each supplement.

With all 11 books enabled: 126 Career profiles, 536 magic profiles (including 17 rituals), 24 Cants, 10 Sword-dancing techniques, 71 rune entries, and 405 fixed-price shop entries. Career alternatives remain explicit choices. Source counts, adaptations and exclusions: inclusion matrix.

Legacy tags identify actual printed rules changed for Fifth Edition, including both Player’s Guides. Compatible material used unchanged has only its source reference. Each badge explains its specific conversion; tags follow affected choices into the folio, review, XP ledger and exports without relabelling every item from an older book. Policy and audit examples: docs/LEGACY.md.
